title: Evidence-selection refusal "not returned whole as a citable record of this task" does not say which cause applies, per locator
outcome: Evidence-selection refusal "not returned whole as a citable record of this task" does not say which cause applies, per locator
acceptance: Each refusal raised by acceptance evidence selection names the locator and the specific cause: a locator mismatch, an omitted body, a truncated summary, or a non-holder record (with the remedy to re-record it as the holder); the shared generic sentence is no longer the whole message.
Tests drive each cause and assert the locator and the cause-specific text; the accept/refuse outcomes themselves are unchanged.
disposal_reason: Subsumed (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-08, on Architect2's dedup intake, TermAl mailbox 3d06f738 #574). w-e16e68f70aad (P1) covers the same refusal "not returned whole as a citable record of this task" with a strict superset of this item's criteria: per-locator cause and remedy for a wrong locator, an omitted body, a truncated summary and a non-holder record, plus multi-record reporting, the other validation failures and unchanged semantics. Its occurrences, including the Engram ones recorded here, carry over by reference.
